'''Nizkif''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He frequented the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Old Galactic Market]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nizkif appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the mission "Partial Eclipse". If the player chooses the dark side option and agrees to sell Black Sun's list of informants and gang leaders, Agent [[Tema Folaris|Folaris]] sends the player to sell it to Nizkif.
